subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this combined Control UI issue remain the umbrella for structured reply metadata plus no-output terminal-state semantics, or should maintainers split/close it in favor of narrower trackers?
rationale: The remaining work crosses Control UI protocol shape, agent runtime context, channel reply contracts, and final fallback delivery policy, so automation should not choose the permanent product contract or tracker shape.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
options.body: Keep this issue open while PR 90745 or a replacement defines reply metadata and issue 87561 settles no-output/final-fallback delivery semantics.

options.title: Split To Canonical Items
options.body: Close this only after maintainers confirm the reply metadata work is fully owned by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88032 or PR 90745 and the no-output half by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.

options.title: Narrow To Current UI Behavior
options.body: Treat Markdown quoting as sufficient for Control UI replies, leaving only the broader final fallback contract tracked elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while PR 90745 or a replacement defines reply metadata and issue 87561 settles no-output/final-fallback delivery semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership touches both the Control UI and agent runtime surfaces involved in choosing the tracker and contract boundary.
